plan.title: A blurry photo: a natural clarifying ask, then a warm miss when no real proof comes

context.text: Night 2 locked in, Yanni. Same deal tonight: in bed, phone down by 9:45, selfie with the lights off.

transcript.text: [photo blurry.jpg: almost all a blurry dark-red smear, like a finger over the lens; nothing can be made out] done

Hey Yanni, that's the second one today that came out as a blurry maroon wash. I can't see you, the bed or the room, and it looks like a finger might be over the lens. Can you grab one more selfie in bed with the phone held a little back? A dark room is fine, I just need to see you in it.

Ha, annoying timing. Try flipping to the back camera, or wipe the lens and use the front one. A dark selfie is totally fine, I just need to see you in bed. If the camera won't cooperate, a quick voice note saying you're in bed with the phone down and lights off works too. Which one can you send?
phone's at 1% I can't keep doing this, just trust me

I believe you, Yanni, but no proof, no check mark. Today goes down as a miss, and that's okay. If you plug in and get a quick voice note to me before you sleep, it still counts. Tomorrow we're back at 9:45 pm, so put the phone on the charger tonight and get me that selfie. Deal?

checks.reason: Asks for a selfie, a photo, and names no typed text as proof.
Three sentences, but the one question sits mid-text and the text ends on a statement, not the question.
Warm and light; 'finger over the lens' is mild but not accusing.
Names a dark selfie or a voice note, never typed text.
Five sentences with one question at the end, over the one-to-three limit.
Easy, friendly tone that keeps it light while the camera is acting up.
Offers a voice note and a selfie, never typed text.
Four sentences, and the closing 'Deal?' follows a request, so it does not fit the short form.
'I believe you' is warm and not suspicious; no guilt or lecture.

conversation.reason: Text 3 keeps asking for proof and says a voice note tonight still counts, instead of closing warmly with tonight not counting.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the unclear photo and the camera trouble lightly and without suspicion, with proof asked for in the right forms. It missed the closing: after the 'just trust me' request, it kept asking for proof, left tonight open with a voice note that 'still counts', and ran over the short-text limit in two replies.
